title: PHP2Shell: Two Critical PHP Flaws Allow Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
content_md: Patch now: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 let unauthenticated attackers run code on web servers running PHP, and details were public before fixes shipped. Article Link: https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/php2shell-critical-vulns-cve-2026-109618-109619
